messages:
Ivy: Need to produce a quick quote-driven case blurb for Caldera Finance. They're happy to do an audio interview only. Goal: embed into a benchmarks landing page and a Twitter thread. Need a short 1-2 sentence quote + approval.

Marco: I can handle the audio interview. 20 min max. Can also suggest a snappy one-liner quote.

Tasha: Keep the copy tight for social. If they mention cost improvements, ask for the baseline. Legal: any redlines aboutFinance customers?

legal-bot: Finance vertical: avoid implying audit or regulatory approval. Also ensure no confidential figures. We need the customer to sign off on the exact quote.

Ivy: Draft quote idea: "Redwood helped us slash inference costs and drop tail latency so models could ship more features."

Marco: Slight tweak: "Redwood lowered our inference costs and reduced tail latency, enabling faster product iteration."

Tasha: Prefer Marco's. Send GDoc after interview for sign-off. We'll route to approvals-bot after legal.

approvals-bot: Approval requested: marketing/customer-blurb-caldera status: waiting_on -> customer_signoff, legal_review.
